findings.section: What to do / Context Files / Ordered handoff
findings.issue: Task 5 requires one completion-summary.json with status, commit, verification, reviews, and proposedDeviation from each of Tasks 1-4, but the producer contracts disagree. Task 1 creates task-1/completion.json and does not require status or verification; Task 2 creates task-2/completion-summary.json with the expected structured schema; Tasks 3 and 4 create completion-summary.md prose files. Therefore Task 5 cannot consume three of its four mandatory handoffs at the declared paths/schema, so it cannot safely consolidate decisions.md or determine blocker/deviation state.
findings.fix: Standardize Tasks 1-4 on one exact task-local artifact, preferably logs/working/task-{N}/completion-summary.json, with the same required keys and value types: task, status, summary, commit, reviews, verification, proposedDeviation. Update every producer What-to-do/AC/verification/detail/post-completion reference and Task 5 consumer links/schema checks to that single contract.

findings.issue: The new task-local completion handoffs are now required cross-task artifacts, but tech-spec Implementation Tasks still omit them from Tasks 1-4 Files to modify and from Task 5 Files to read. decisions.md ownership is correctly reflected for Tasks 5 and 9 and in Shared resources, but the producer-to-consumer handoff files themselves are not represented in the technical source of truth.
findings.fix: After standardizing the handoff path/schema, add each completion-summary.json to the corresponding Tasks 1-4 Files to modify and add all four paths to Task 5 Files to read in tech-spec. Keep the task-local instance count at one per implementation task and decisions.md writers dependency-ordered as Task 5 then Task 9.
